featureCutoff: strictly earlier Chicago game dates; no selected-game outcomes or later games
candidateRule: players in each team's most recent earlier box-score roster plus other/unseen scorer
baseline: earlier team first-score counts plus 1 pseudocount per listed candidate and other
challenger: last-lineup reference: start-conditioned smoothed rate for reference starters; appearance-conditioned smoothed rate for others; normalized with other
primaryMetric: mean team-event log loss; both teams evaluated together per fixture
promotion: at least 1 percent relative test log-loss improvement with positive lower 95 percent paired game-bootstrap and series/time-block improvement; no more than 1 percent relative Brier deterioration; observed candidate coverage at least baseline coverage
interpretation: retrospective corrected-data research; 2025-26 already inspected; no claim of unseen live performance or profitability
prospectiveRule: evaluate first valid issued forecast per fixture/target; retain revisions, exclusions and withheld cases
